transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, you've reached our automated assistant. How can I help?
Hi, I'd like to schedule a fall tune-up for my heating system.
Could I have your name to check for an existing account?
Thanks, Jen. Can you please give me the phone number on your account and the ZIP code of your address?
The phone number is 631-555-0155 and the ZIP code is 11706.
Thanks, Jen. Tell me, what kind of property will the service be at? For example, a house, condo, or something else?
We do serve your area. Now, can you describe the heating system issue or request again, please?
I want to get a fall tune-up for my heating system.

We can send a technician for your fall tune-up tomorrow, Wednesday, between noon and 2 in the afternoon, or between 4 and 6 in the afternoon. Or we have Thursday, November 5, between 8 and 10 in the morning. Which would you prefer?
I'll take the Thursday morning slot, between 8 and 10. By the way, I noticed a rotten-egg smell in the basement this morning, but it's gone now.

This could be a gas leak, so please leave the house now and take everyone with you. Don't touch light switches, appliances or phones on your way out. Once you're outside and away from the house, call nine-one-one, or National Grid at one, eight hundred, four nine zero, zero zero four five. Don't go back in until they tell you it's safe.
Okay, thanks for the warning. I'll leave right away. Goodbye.
Please leave now and call nine-one-one from outside. Goodbye.

tone.name: tone
tone.detail: The conversation was warm, clear, brief, asked one thing at a time, avoided repetition and jargon, and did not invent facts or promises.
